Title: Another question about ARMY OF RATS

Messages.Author: Fernando Costa
Messages.Body:
This came up during last game:
My prey had an ARMY OF RATS wich was brought in play by me.
He was ousted.
Does the ARMY OF RATS continue in play damaging my NEW prey, or is it burned ?

Thanks in advance

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"henrik isaksson" <PLEASEDONTSP...@spray.se> wrote in message
news:2sfth8F...@uni-berlin.de...


Let's not go confusing people, now. :-)

What henrik means is:

The Army of Rats you play is yours; you have it. (Contrast
to the statement above which misspoke: "My prey had ...").

Since it is yours, it is unaffected by the fate of your prey.

Since it remains in play, it continues to have an effect.

That effect targets your current (new) prey.
